description: Create or update an event's intake form config (upsert by event_id + form_type). form_type: 'speaker-info', 'sponsor-info' or 'call-for-speakers'. `config` is the form-builder JSON: {fields: [{id, label, type, enabled, required, options, helpText, sectionStart, maxWords}], metadata: {title, subtitle, showTitle, shareCaption, welcomeInfo: {tabLabel, heading, body}}}.
name: set_form_config
title: Set intake form config
